verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API platform like Mistral, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents issuing API keys restricted by scope, permission, or resource for an agent. The usage-limits page mentions Workspace caps and API limits, but those are spending and rate controls, not least-privilege credential scoping, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
